Home Payments & Refunds How do I request a refund? Edited Overview We want you to love ourdream! But if you believe you're eligible for refund, here's the process to follow. Refund Eligibility: We cannot issue refunds for product that has used more than 25% of it's amount. Monthly subscriptions cannot be refunded if the coin has been used up, annual subscriptions may be eligible for full or partial refund. How do I request a refund? To request a refund: Go to https://ourdream.ai/profile Click the "Request Help" button In your message, include: The product (subscription or coins) The charge date and amount Reason for the refund request Our support team will collect your request within 24-48 hours - sometimes this can take longer for complicated requests. How long do refunds take? Once approved: Credit/debit cards: 5-10 business days Cryptocurrency: Cannot be refunded The timeframe depends on your payment provider, not ourdream. What happens to my account after a refund? After a refund is processed: If you're cancelling a subscription it will be cancelled. Your images and videos will be blurred until you are re-subscribed Any unused dreamcoins will be removed You can resubscribe anytime Still have questions?
